items.title: High-throughput Transfer Manager for Amazon S3 in Rust is now generally available
items.summary: High-throughput transfers to and from Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) often require manual tuning of threads, connections, and memory. Transfer Manager for Amazon S3, a high-level transfer library for Rust, handles this work for you. It is now generally available (GA). Since the developer preview launch in March 2025, we have redesigned the library. […]

items.title: Announcing the developer preview of the AWS SDK for Python v4
items.summary: The AWS SDK for Python v4 is now available in developer preview. It provides typed, modular clients for a growing list of AWS services, including Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Bedrock. Clients are available in synchronous and asynchronous (async) versions. Some features, such as event streaming, are currently available […]
